notes.title: Takara Cards: Academy is available!
notes.content:
Hello Cadets!

Takara Cards: Academy is a free prologue to our newest game, Takara Cards!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932210/Takara_Cards/

In it, you can create your character and explore the first sector of the game, as well as having access to the game's Codex and Tutorial.

And don't worry: you can continue playing later with your cadet in the full version of Takara Cards!

Don't forget to follow our Steam page!

Happy hunting, Cadets!
